construct: NR3C2 encodes the mineralocorticoid receptor. Heterozygous loss-of-function variants cause renal pseudohypoaldosteronism type 1, in which the kidney is resistant to aldosterone, producing salt wasting, hyponatremia, hyperkalemia, metabolic acidosis, and compensatory elevation of renin and aldosterone.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Neonatal salt wasting, hyperkalemic non-gap acidosis, high renin/high aldosterone, normal sweat chloride, and heterozygous NR3C2 loss identify renal PHA1 from mineralocorticoid-receptor resistance.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: 21-hydroxylase deficiency and adrenal hypoaldosteronism lower effective aldosterone production; diabetic type 4 RTA has low renin/aldosterone and adult context; systemic ENaC-PHA1 affects multiple salt-wasting epithelia and does not match the proven NR3C2 defect.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The NR3C2 genotype directly establishes mineralocorticoid-receptor resistance, while the hormonal pattern rules out hormone deficiency.
